Chao Ong / Ba:
toi NGUYEN MANH thuoc DOI XU
LY NO cua Ong/Ba . Hom qua toi
da co gang lien he,di khao sat tai
dia phuong . Xet thay hanh vi tron
tranh khong tu giac ra TRA NO
va con co dau hieu TRON TRANH
khoan vay. Yeu cau Ong / ba va
nguoi nha co mat tai dia chi :
Truoc 15h toi se lien he lai
de tien hanh vao nha Thu Hoi it
nhat 2 thang no. Neu tiep tuc
tron tranh, tra ho so ve PHONG
PHAP LY to cao hanh vi Vi Pham
Phap Luat va yeu cau Den Bu Hop
Dong.
